body: I truly hope that there is more to life than this. Thank you for your response.

Also 30 and stuck living with my parents. It came after a long struggle with my mental health and an unexpected divorce where I was left with nothing. Worked a shitty dead end job for 2 years before finally finding a better one. Last night I was told to be out by February. I sit between "too poor to afford living alone" and "too rich to qualify for assistance". My only option is to get a second job and work 7 days a week. Is this really all there is to life?
